**The symmetric algebra $\mathrm{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal E)=\bigoplus_{n\ge 0}\mathrm{Sym}^n(\mathcal E)$**, which is quasi-coherent and graded. So $\mathbb V(\mathcal E)=\underline{\mathrm{Spec}}_S\big(\mathrm{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal E)\big)$.

With this undualized convention, a $T$-point of $\mathbb V(\mathcal E)$ over $S$ is an $\mathcal O_T$-linear map $\mathcal E_T\to\mathcal O_T$. Hence the sheaf of sections of $\mathbb V(\mathcal E)$ is the dual $\mathcal E^\vee$, not $\mathcal E$ itself.

$$\bar\theta_U=\frac{2\sum_{i=1}^n X_i}{\chi^2_{2n,\,1-\alpha}}=\frac{2n\bar X}{\chi^2_{2n,\,1-\alpha}}$$

Here $\chi^2_{2n,1-\alpha}$ is the upper $1-\alpha$ point, i.e. the lower $\alpha$ quantile, of $\chi^2_{2n}$. This follows because $2\sum X_i/\theta \sim \chi^2_{2n}$.

The UMA $1-\alpha$ confidence set is therefore $0<\theta\le \dfrac{2\sum X_i}{\chi^2_{2n,1-\alpha}}$.
